title: BFG Tools ship data
description: Ship profiles and fleet lists of Battlefleet Gothic: Remastered, extracted from the Fleets Book WiP v0.36 and the Rulebook v1.10. See data/README.md for which fields are stable.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this interface, MAJOR.MINOR. MAJOR changes when a stable field is removed or renamed.

src.description: The books the data was read from, as one line of text.

ships.description: Ship profiles by id. The id is the profile's page in Fleets WiP v0.36, frozen when the apps moved to v0.40 (extractor/ship_ids.json), with a letter when one page has several ("472c"); profiles new in v0.40 have an id that is not a page ("am128"). The ship's own pg is its page in the current book.

pg.description: Fleets Book page of the profile (its picture is on this page).

fl.description: The book's fleet heading, upper case ("IMPERIAL NAVY").

nm.description: Class name as printed, upper case ("APOCALYPSE CLASS BATTLESHIP").

bp.description: Base points, or null when the profile has no price of its own.

tl.description: Label of the turret column in the book ("TURRETS", or what a fleet calls them).

aw.description: Armament rows: [name, range/speed, firepower/strength, arc], as printed.

sr.description: Special rules text of the profile, as printed.

op.description: Options text of the profile, as printed (may be empty).

chap.description: Index of the book chapter the profile is in.

ol.description: Options the apps can apply, resolved from op. Internal: the shape may change.

nm.description: Fleet list name ("Imperial Navy — Gothic Sector").

pg.description: Fleets Book page where the list starts.

race.description: Race used by the reserve and ally rules, or null.

secs.description: Sections of the list in book order (commanders, capital ships, escorts, ...).

rules.description: The section's restrictions, machine-checked or marked for the player. Internal: the shape may change.

k.description: Row kind: a unit to buy, an upgrade, or a commander.

p.description: Points, or null when the row has no fixed price.

r.description: Ship profile id (a key of ships) the row buys, if any.

src_page.description: Fleets Book page of the row.
